summary: A local service business that prices by the job and works by appointment: moving, cleaning, repairs, installation, car service or washing. The site's core is an instant quote calculator or a service picker that shows price and time live, a price list, a booking or quote request, trust signals (insurance, warranty, crew) and a searchable FAQ.

pages.purpose: Give a price or a ready-by time within seconds, back it with proof (insurance, warranty, reviews, crew), and send the visitor to a full quote or a booking.

sections.purpose: The promise plus a quick estimate: two or three choices (service type, job size) give a 'from' price or time that opens the full calculator prefilled.
fields: Service types for the quick estimate
'From' price per combination and the assumptions behind it
sections.notes: Segmented radio groups and a polite live region for the figure. A memorable version draws the job: a measured floor plan like a survey sheet that fills with the load as the home size changes, or a board of today's bays as a departures board (decorative; the text carries the meaning).
alternatives: estimator: the quick estimate as a two-question estimator beside the headline, its CTA opening the full calculator prefilled

sections.purpose: Hard trust figures: years, jobs done, insurance cover, warranty, rating.
fields: Three or four figures with label

sections.purpose: Build the job: pick the vehicle or home size and the jobs; see the price and the time it will be ready, live, and go to booking with the job kept.

fields: Most-booked jobs with duration and price per size
Which jobs run in parallel (e.g. workshop and wash lane)
sections.notes: Estimator with the vehicle or home size as option cards and the jobs as add-on cards (price and duration in each card's meta); the formula returns the total, the ready-by time and the duration as facts, and summaryExtra draws a two-lane timeline when two teams work in parallel. Compact on home (most-booked jobs), full on the services page. Keep the selection in a shared store (controlled values) so it survives page changes and a language switch; the CTA goes to booking with the job kept.

styles.name: trusty blue
styles.why: Moving, cleaning and household services: corporate blue, clear sans, spec-sheet prices; brisk motion where prices settle into place when they change.

styles.name: workshop dark
styles.why: A garage, car wash or repair shop: dark with a safety-yellow brand accent, grotesk with mono numerals, compact and quick; a workshop, not a show.

styles.name: fresh and friendly
styles.why: Cleaning, gardening or small repair businesses that want an approachable, light look.

pitfalls: Calculator prices that do not match the price list or the final invoice; derive both from one pricing model and state the assumptions behind 'from' prices.
A live estimate presented as a fixed price; show a range, state what can change it (access, extra items) and who confirms it.
Hidden surcharges (weekend, month-end, distance, VAT) that only appear on the invoice; show them as line items in the estimate.
Insurance and warranty claims without the cover amount, insurer or terms.
Booking calendars that offer closed days or full slots, or have no cancellation policy.
Multi-step forms that lose answers on going back or on a language switch, or do not announce step changes and live totals to screen readers.
Long forms on mobile with tiny segmented controls; keep touch targets large and let people call instead.
Collecting addresses and phone numbers without a privacy notice.
